text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, I challenge you! You and me, on
the
racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Can it wait till after I finish this pork
bun? After
all...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Pork buns should be eaten when they're
still hot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course you should finish that first!
Now hurry
up and eat it!
